atAGlance: Gà rô ti is Vietnamese rô ti chicken, usually with soy or fish-sauce glaze, gentle sweetness, and rice.
whatItIs: Gà rô ti is Vietnamese-style roasted or braised chicken with a savory-sweet glaze, often served with rice, cucumber, pickles, and chicken juices.
howToEnjoy: Eat the glazed chicken with rice so the savory-sweet juices do not overwhelm. Pickles or cucumber keep the plate bright.
howLocalsOrder: Order gà rô ti when you want chicken with a glossy roasted-braised flavor. Ask for extra rice, extra pickles, or less chili before the plate is dressed.
worthKnowing: Rô ti in Vietnam often means a local roast-braise style rather than Western rotisserie.
goodToKnow: Rô ti is usually sweet-savory and glossy, often with garlic and soy or fish-sauce depth; ask for rice to catch the pan juices.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà rô ti.
